steps.title: Interactive consent
steps.detail: Consent completed and an account label was derived.

steps.title: The granted scope reaches appDataFolder
steps.detail: An appDataFolder query succeeded with the granted token.

steps.title: Create the probe vault marker
steps.detail: The vault marker was created once and the identical repeat was reported as a duplicate.

steps.title: Identical duplicate write is tolerated
steps.detail: 2 physical files share the logical key and the properties query returns all of them; reads stay deterministic.

steps.title: Different body at the same key is corruption
steps.detail: The adapter reported corruption instead of selecting a candidate by name or modified time.

steps.title: An interrupted upload persists its session
steps.detail: The session survived the interruption in the SQLite ledger.

steps.title: A fresh provider resumes from the accepted offset
steps.detail: The resumed upload produced the declared hash and the session ledger was cleared on completion.

steps.title: An expired stored session is replaced
steps.detail: An expired session was discarded and a new one started without losing the logical upload.

steps.title: A session Drive no longer knows is restarted
steps.detail: Drive rejected the stale session and the adapter restarted the upload.

steps.title: Natural service-side session expiry
steps.detail: Google expires a resumable session after roughly a week, which no single sitting can observe. Still owed: leave one interrupted upload in the ledger, return after the expiry window, and confirm the adapter restarts it without operator action.

steps.title: A deleted object is gone from appDataFolder
steps.detail: The object is absent from the appDataFolder listing. That listing excludes trashed files, so it proves absence from the working set; Drive `files.delete` is what makes it permanent.

steps.title: Repeating the delete is success
steps.detail: A repeated permanent delete resolved rather than throwing on 404.

steps.title: Publish both revocation kinds and residue
steps.detail: Two revocation kinds and seven residue objects are published.

steps.title: A purge stopped between pages resumes
steps.detail: The purge resumed after each interruption and finished without operator intervention.

steps.title: Only revocation markers remain
steps.detail: Every residue object is gone and both revocation kinds survived the purge.

steps.title: Deterministic fixture is present
steps.detail: The fixture bytes come from the frozen Phase-0 generator.

steps.title: A large upload survives an interruption
steps.detail: The interrupted transfer left a resumable session in durable storage.

steps.title: The upload resumes and completes
steps.detail: The completed upload carries the host-frozen fixture hash.

steps.title: The download streams to disk and verifies
steps.detail: Byte count and SHA-256 match the frozen fixture; the adapter never buffered the whole object in JavaScript.

steps.title: A partial download resumes by byte range
steps.detail: The adapter requested only the missing range and the completed file still verified.

steps.title: Renew without interactive consent
steps.detail: A cleared access token was renewed non-interactively and the account label survived.

steps.title: A Drive call succeeds on the renewed token
steps.detail: An authorized Drive write completed after the silent renewal.

groups.title: Remove probe objects from the test account

steps.title: Delete every object in the probe vault
steps.detail: Removed 4 probe objects, including revocation markers and the vault marker.

steps.title: Remove probe vaults left by earlier runs
steps.detail: Removed 3 stale probe vaults; only probe-… vaults are eligible.
